title: p590 (psalter wk II Sunday Off. lect.) prints 'Salve dies (LHym 210) vel Dies ætasque (LHym 183)': add Dies ætasque as a further 2.4H1 option?
prompt: p590, psalter week II Dominica, Off. lect. H: 'Quando officium dicitur noctu vel summo mane: Mediæ noctis (LHym 209)' / 'Quando officium dicitur diurno tempore: Salve dies (LHym 210) vel Dies ætasque (LHym 183)'. Loaded now (wkday 1, wknum_mod_2 0, OFFREAD.hymn): option 1 Mediæ noctis (gregobase:4610, no option_txt, see #28), option 2 Salve dies (gregobase:10458, 'Quando officium dicitur diurno tempore'). The hymn index (p1217) codes Dies ætasque (#105, gregobase:15628) only as 1.3H1 Ol (week I Sunday, p550, where it is the 'diurno tempore' hymn), so the 'vel Dies ætasque' on p590 is not modeled.
